role: Villager weather shelter: at night (or when a storm is due) a villager in a village picks the nearest unrestricted door and walks to its inside point.

members.name: entityObj
members.note: folded: the task runs on the villager itself (struct living)

members.name: EntityAIMoveIndoors
members.note: registered as AIC_MOVE_INDOORS, priority 2, mutex 1, speed 1.0

members.name: shouldExecute
members.note: (!isDaytime || isRaining || !canSpawnLightningBolt) gate with an_world.raining (World.isRaining, set per world pass); hasNoSky has no villager to read it (villagers do not reach the Nether or the End)

members.name: startExecuting
members.note: insidePos = -1; beyond 16 blocks it walks to a findRandomTargetBlockTowards(14,3) point, otherwise straight to the door inside point + 0.5

members.name: resetTask
members.note: saves the door's inside X/Z, clears doorInfo

notes: The findNearestVillage(14) and findNearestDoorUnrestricted calls go through village.c's vc_find_nearest_village and v_find_nearest_door_unrestricted; the 1-in-50 draw matches. lane/villagetrade 2026-09-27: the tail-only evidence (X-01/X-02) now points at the full re-records persist-village-full-s42, whose native replay starts before the behaviour.
